focus: Fixed a continuous-integration blackout: the automated browser test suite had been failing on every change for over 17 hours because the local preview server did not apply the same redirect rules as the live site. The preview is now faithful to production, and the checks that guard every public page are producing verdicts again.
nextStep: Tidy how the site builds its navigation, and refresh the game cover artwork.
